## Provenance and legal checklist

- [ ] I authored this change and did not copy source, rules, strings, tests, comments, or architecture from Mole or another cleaner.
- [ ] I signed the approved TrashIT CLA (outside contributions remain blocked until legal review is complete).
- [ ] New cleanup knowledge cites vendor documentation, native output, or an original local observation in `docs/CLEANUP_RULES.md`.
- [ ] New dependencies are recorded in `THIRD_PARTY.md` and are compatible with both GPL and commercial targets.
- [ ] Tests cover negative and changed-state behavior, not only successful cleanup.
